leadText:
Evolving Again is the opening theme song for the English dub of the third season of , Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope. It is the twenty-ninth English opening in the Pokémon animated series overall. The instrumental ending version first aired with Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part One), while the opening version was used from Following Traces of Laquium. The opening animation is composed of clips from the fifth Pokémon Horizons: The Series Japanese opening, GET BACK, while the ending animation is composed of clips from the fourth Pokémon Horizons: The Series Japanese ending, Ready Go.

The full version of the song was released on iTunes, Amazon, Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube, YouTube Music, , , and on January 6, 2026.

This opening theme features one of the leitmotifs from the soundtrack of the dubbed version of , specifically the one used during Mega Evolution.
